eval_dimensions.name: Licence Decision Gate
eval_dimensions.description: A non-commercial or unknown voice fires AskUserQuestion before the first synthesis, and is never used silently

eval_dimensions.name: Preference Persistence
eval_dimensions.description: An accepted voice choice is pinned to ~/.config/Dev10x/tts.yaml so the gate fires once, not per run

eval_dimensions.name: Wrapper Delegation
eval_dimensions.description: Piper and kokoro-tts are invoked through scripts/synthesize.py, never as raw binary calls

eval_dimensions.name: Language Routing
eval_dimensions.description: The engine follows the language — Kokoro for English, Piper for Polish — and is never named by the caller

eval_dimensions.name: Failure Visibility
eval_dimensions.description: A missing binary or voice produces an actionable error naming the fix, never silent or empty audio

evals.name: Licence gate fires for a non-commercial voice
evals.description: check reports a non-null warning and licence_accepted false, so the gate must block before any synthesis

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is called before the first batch when check returns a non-null warning
The gate names the actual licence, not a generic caution
No inline 'is that ok?' question appears before the AskUserQuestion call

evals.name: No re-ask once the voice is pinned and accepted
evals.description: check reports warning null because the resolved voice carries a recorded acceptance
evals.input: /Dev10x:tts synthesize narration with the pinned voice

assertions.signal: No licence AskUserQuestion fires when the resolved voice carries a recorded acceptance

evals.name: Keeping a non-commercial voice persists the acceptance
evals.description: Supervisor picks Keep at the licence gate; the choice must survive the session

assertions.signal: synthesize.py pin --voice <voice> --accept-licence is run after the supervisor accepts
The pin targets ~/.config/Dev10x/tts.yaml, not a file under the repo's .claude/

evals.name: Synthesis always routes through the wrapper
evals.description: Narration is synthesized for a walkthrough recording
evals.input: /Dev10x:tts synthesize narration for a qa-self capture

assertions.signal: Every synthesis goes through the wrapper script path
No bare piper invocation appears in the transcript
No bare kokoro-tts invocation appears in the transcript

evals.name: Polish narration reaches an engine that speaks it
evals.description: Kokoro has no Polish weights, so a Polish walkthrough must resolve a pl_PL Piper voice
evals.input: /Dev10x:tts synthesize Polish narration for a qa-self capture

assertions.signal: The resolved voice is a pl_PL Piper voice, reached via --lang pl or an explicit --voice
The Kokoro pf_/pm_ voices are Brazilian Portuguese and are never used for Polish

evals.name: The English default does not fire the licence gate
evals.description: Kokoro's Apache-2.0 weights mean check returns warning null on the default English path
evals.input: /Dev10x:tts synthesize English narration for a qa-self capture

assertions.signal: No licence AskUserQuestion fires when the resolved voice is a Kokoro one

evals.name: A missing voice names the download command
evals.description: The configured voice is not installed in the resolved voices directory
evals.input: /Dev10x:tts synthesize narration with an uninstalled voice

assertions.signal: The error names the download command with the resolved voices directory
The run stops rather than producing a silent video or an empty track

should_trigger: Narration or voice-over audio is needed for a walkthrough recording
A Dev10x:qa-self capture should be narrated
Text needs to be synthesized to speech with a local voice
Narration is needed in a language other than English
should_not_trigger: Capturing the walkthrough recording itself (use Dev10x:qa-self)
Converting or verifying evidence files (use qa-self's own scripts)
Analyzing a PR for QA needs (use Dev10x:qa-scope)
